# `unconditional-busy-loop`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports `while (true)` bodies with no visible break, return, or call.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Such a loop cannot make externally visible blocking progress and can consume a
CPU indefinitely.

## When it fires

It targets simple unconditional loop bodies; calls suppress the warning because
they may block, terminate, or alter control flow.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
var flag: bool = false;

fn wait() void {
    while (true) {
        if (flag) {}
    }
}
```
